title: Why Cars Got A Third Brake Light

scenes.narration: Somewhere in the back window of every car sits a third brake light, higher and more centered than the other two.
scenes.note: Establish the triangle: two low and wide, one high and centred.

scenes.narration: It exists because the original pair are easy to misread.

scenes.narration: They sit low, they sit far apart, and they are right beside tail lights that are already glowing.
scenes.note: Three reasons, three marks. The tail lights already being on is the important one.
